name: Unknown distribution contract unchecked allocation-sum overflow
summary: The unverified Solidity 0.7.6 distribution contract's single-token deposit function 0x317de4f6(token,(recipient,amount)[]) sums allocation amounts without overflow checks, pulls only that sum from the caller, then credits each nonzero recipient its full amount as a claimable balance. The attacker passed a zero-address entry of 2^256-97812920708 and a self entry equal to the contract's USDT balance, paid 1 USDT base unit, and claim() paid out all 97,812.920709 USDT held for unclaimed allocations; a second actor repeated it for the residual USDe.

loss.notes: Gross victim depletion equals the contract's entire pre-exploit USDT and USDe balances; the attacker-supplied 1+1 USDT base units and 1 wei USDe paid into 0x317de4f6 are returned inside the claim outflows and are not loss. Stablecoins valued at par; downstream swaps to WETH are excluded. The second campaign (0xc513e4f5..., source-6) happened 696 seconds after the anchor against the same contract.

ageReset.description: Direct immutable runtime; the unchecked sum in the 0x317de4f6 deposit path exists from deployment and no configuration value bears on it.

sources.note: Reviewed root cause, first exercise, artifact identity and age history. Victim 0xf0a105d93eec8781e15222ad754fcf1264568c97 is unverified (Etherscan V2 contract.getsourcecode returns empty SourceCode); CBOR metadata ends solc 0x000706 (0.7.6, no checked arithmetic). Runtime dispatcher: 0x317de4f6 -> 0x01a4: whenNotPaused, sum = internal 0x095c over the (address,uint256)[] amounts, where the loop body is a bare ADD (bytes 82019150, no overflow check), require(sum>0,'BADINPUT'), safeTransferFrom(token,msg.sender,this,sum) at 0x0998, then for every entry with recipient!=0 and amount>0 credits recipient's claimable (token,amount) list at 0x0b38 with the full amount. claim() 0x4e71d92d (0x0592) transfers every credited amount to msg.sender and deletes the list. The two-token deposit 0x4d1ba565 sums through SafeMath add 0x1025 ('SafeMath: addition overflow') and is safe. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of source-1 (block 24707679, index 0, sender EOA 0x7bd736631afbe1d3795a94f60574f7fa0ae89347, creation of 0x328a0b37..., which creates 0x0ed84fce...): inside a Uniswap V4 unlock 0x0ed84fce takes 1 USDT base unit, reads USDT.balanceOf(victim)=97812920709, calls victim 0x317de4f6(USDT,[(0x0,0xff..ffe939e5467c),(0x0ed84fce,0x16c61ab985)]) whose sum wraps to 1, victim transferFrom pulls 1 unit (receipt log 2), then claim() pays 97812920709 USDT (log 3); proceeds swapped to 45.341889877898810010 WETH (log 6). First-exercise scan: Etherscan V2 account.txlist for the victim (blocks 0..99999999) returns 26 transactions, all successful claim(); tokentx returns 83 transfers. Every pre-exploit inflow (11 transactions, blocks 23549055..24698247, all from 0xde7ad8410ef0ae515584be29b99ab2f524da3ca0 or 0xff1a630a...) traces to an internal 0x4d1ba565 call, and each deposit is paid out exactly to its listed recipients; 0x317de4f6 is first called in source-1. Any successful 0x317de4f6 call must transfer a positive sum, so the token-transfer inventory bounds all calls. eth_getCode(victim) is 0x at block 23530739; keccak256 of runtime is 0xcf3261cb41a30b34b98e3d9c10c1fbcfd27e8656d0342b335580963732402521 at blocks 23530740 and 24707678. Source-2 (block 23530740, index 190) is EOA 0x791cab5cbe994526f686ece738ae0919a8daf98d calling CreateX 0xba5ed099633d3b313e4d5f7bdc1305d3c28ba5ed deployCreate2 (0x26307668); callTracer shows CREATE2 from CreateX to the victim, so creatorAddress is CreateX. The runtime has no upgrade, delegatecall or self-destruct selector (selectors 317de4f6, 402914f5, 43d726d6, 4d1ba565, 4e71d92d, 54fd4d50 version()='0.2.15', 597e1fb5, 5c975abb, 715018a6, 8da5cb5b, f2fde38b, fcfff16f); owner() at 24707678 is the deployer EOA and paused()=false. Deployment supplies the age.

Reviewed complete gross loss. eth_call USDT(0xdac17f958d2ee523a2206206994597c13d831ec7).balanceOf(victim) = 97812920709 at block 24707678, 1 at 24707679, 0 at 24707737; USDe(0x4c9edd5852cd905f086c759e8383e09bff1e68b3).balanceOf(victim) = 2591467933559023257 at 24707678 and 24707679, 0 at 24707737. Source-1 receipt: USDT log 2 attacker->victim 1, log 3 victim->0x0ed84fce 97812920709. Source-5 (block 24707737, index 12, EOA 0xc513e4f5d7a93a1dd5b7c4d9f6cc2f52d2f1f8e7 creating 0x086f12e381ddc8ee60f747370da5b0335f870dcb, helper 0xf53089e4b3d425edcbeeba60226f16d0ed5022b9): callTracer shows 0x317de4f6(USDT,[(0x0,2^256-1),(0xf53089e4,2)]) and 0x317de4f6(USDe,[(0x0,0xff..ffdc0941a505661967),(0xf53089e4,0x23f6be5afa99e69a)]) each followed by claim(); receipt USDT logs 131/132 in 1 out 2, USDe logs 136/137 in 1 out 2591467933559023258. Net victim depletion: USDT 97812920709 (6 decimals), USDe 2591467933559023257 (18 decimals), i.e. both pre-exploit balances in full. Tokentx after 24707737 shows only an unsolicited 1 HEX inflow (block 24812697) and a new 0x4d1ba565 deposit at 25333392 that was claimed normally. Neither attacker's other contract-creation transactions (7bd736: 7; c513e4: 30 after block 24690000) call 0x317de4f6 on any other address. No other chain has code at this CreateX address (eth_getCode on BSC, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon returns 0x).
USDT and USDe valued at USD 1 par at the transfer timestamps (source-1 1774117751, source-5 1774118447); total 97812.920709 + 2.591467933559023257 = 97815.512176933559023257 USD.
